label: target-network-repair
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=<WORKDIR>/E4/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i <WORKDIR>/E4/id_ed25519 -p 22145 root@127.0.0.1 bash -s
script:
set -euxo pipefail
nmcli con mod e4-bound 802-3-ethernet.mac-address <MAC-9>
nmcli -w 10 con up e4-bound ifname ens4
ip -br address show dev ens4
ping -I ens4 -c 2 -W 2 10.44.0.2
nmcli -f connection.uuid,connection.interface-name,802-3-ethernet.mac-address con show e4-bound
nmcli con down e4-bound
